label: Organise the reunion yourself

risk.result: Half the deposits never arrive. You are the villain of the group chat.

label: Sing at the reception

risk.result: You forget the words. The video goes round the family.

label: Offer to be the godparent

risk.result: Godparents, it turns out, pay for a lot.

label: Take up yoga for a month in Bali

risk.result: You do a pose that is not for beginners.

label: Stay up and write the novel

risk.result: It reads like it was written at 4am.

label: Quit and retrain as a pilot

risk.result: The simulator course fails you. Twice.

label: Take the competing offer to the boss

risk.result: They wave you out the door. The other offer was a bluff.

label: Report the scheme and name them publicly

risk.result: Your classmate's mum is not pleased.

label: Organise a tenants' strike

risk.result: The landlord serves notice on the ringleader. You.

label: Ask to join the band

risk.result: You are worse than the drummer. They say so.

label: Sell the car and buy a motorbike

risk.result: The first wet road teaches you a lot.

label: Move them in, and move your life

risk.result: Three adults, one kitchen, nobody speaking.

label: Sign up for a full health overhaul

risk.result: The scans find three things to worry about.

label: Fly out and surprise them

risk.result: They were not alone. Awkward.

label: Quit drinking, and say it publicly

risk.result: Month two is a very long month.

label: Go on a week-long retreat

risk.result: You cried in front of strangers. Not in the good way.

label: Run the whole thing barefoot

risk.result: Your feet look like a crime scene.

label: Open a pottery studio

risk.result: The kiln costs more than the building.

label: Quit and go for a year

risk.result: Nobody is holding your desk for you.

label: Find the dog and return it in person

risk.result: The dog does not like you. The family does not like you either.

label: Organise the whole event

risk.result: The permit never came. The vegetables got wet.

label: Go fully silver, early

risk.result: It goes yellow. Everyone notices.

label: Ask them what the kids are into

risk.result: They explain it slowly. You are now a meme.

label: Invest in the truck and drive it too

risk.result: The food truck is the talk of the festival.

label: Go all in on index funds and a side gig

risk.result: The market dips the week after you commit.

label: Fly out and look them up

risk.result: They have a fiancé. And a dog. And a lovely house.

label: Persuade the other eleven

risk.result: You were wrong. The man walked free.

label: Start a rat sanctuary

risk.result: Your landlord finds the second hundred.

label: Walk out and open a café

risk.result: Coffee margins are cruel.

label: Strap the ladder to the roof and go up

risk.result: The strap holds. The gutter does not.

death.cause: The ladder went one way. You went the other.

label: Run a marathon on the day

risk.result: You hit the wall at mile eleven and stay there.

death.cause: The heart gave out at mile eighteen.

label: Quit the job and drive across the continent

risk.result: You find yourself. You don't find a job.

label: Take up the violin

risk.result: The neighbours leave a note. Then another.

label: Take up fell running instead

risk.result: Surgery. Both knees.

label: Pay for the private full-body scan

risk.result: They find three odd shadows. All benign. After three weeks.

label: Go vegetarian and take up swimming

risk.result: You are tiresome at dinner parties.

label: Call an ambulance and cancel everything

risk.result: It was heartburn. The paramedic is polite.

label: Record every story on video

risk.result: It is a lot of footage. They are a lot of stories.

label: Move abroad together to somewhere warm

risk.result: Healthcare abroad is another story.

label: Read their favourite poem and sing

risk.result: You break down mid-verse. No one blames you. You do.

label: Organise a memorial weekend

risk.result: Old grudges came too.

label: Go into business with your rival

risk.result: They steal the client list and leave.

label: Take the payout and start your own firm

risk.result: Year one is fine. Year two is not.

label: Build your own tool instead

risk.result: Nobody uses it. It is very elegant.

label: Move it all into property

risk.result: The market turns. So does your stomach.

label: Write your own seminar

risk.result: Four people come. Two are your cousins.

label: Train for a channel swim

risk.result: The water is much colder than the pool.

death.cause: The sea took you, quietly, halfway across.

label: Found your own club

risk.result: Every committee ends in a feud.

label: Host a reconciliation dinner

risk.result: It was a very long dinner.

label: Start a scholarship in your name

risk.result: The paperwork consumes a year.

label: Hire a trainer and do the programme

risk.result: The trainer is lovely. The programme is evil.

label: Shave it and grow a magnificent beard

risk.result: The beard comes in grey and patchy.

label: Go for the full makeover

risk.result: Your face has made a decision without you.

label: Sell the house and go back to college

risk.result: You're the oldest on the course. By far.

risk.result: It becomes a local tourist trap.

risk.result: It's still bad. You're still tired.

risk.result: Guests are a different species.
